consequence.statement: Listed metrics are exposed with the `loki_` prefix instead of `cortex_`, so queries, dashboards or alerts using the old names will not match unless metrics_namespace is set to `cortex`.
consequence.remediation: Set metrics_namespace to `cortex` to keep old names, or update dashboards and alerts.

assertion.statement: Some Loki metrics' prefix changes from `cortex_` to `loki_` by default (metrics_namespace default `loki`); set `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` to keep the old prefix.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Whether dashboards/alerts use the affected cortex_ metrics is not visible in config; metrics_namespace config not shown as a checkable input here.
